source_row.rationale: Smart pump technology includes built-in dose error-reduction software with a drug library containing pre-established safe dosing limits for various medications. When a nurse programs an infusion rate or dose that falls outside these established safe limits, the pump alerts the nurse, prompting review and correction before the infusion proceeds — though the nurse must still verify pump settings, since the technology is a safeguard, not a replacement for clinical verification.
